product_overview: CleanStreet is a civic web app for residents to report local waste issues, browse community reports, and get waste-sorting guidance. It also includes a demo admin workflow for updating report statuses and bilingual, accessible navigation.
core_goals: Report local waste issues with details and optional photos
Browse and filter community waste reports by status, type, and locality
Search household items to find the correct waste-sorting category
Manage report status in a demo admin workflow
Switch between English and Hindi and navigate the app accessibly

features.name: Submit Waste Issue Report
features.description: Lets a resident submit a local waste issue with category, location, optional description, and optional photo, then review the confirmation details.
user_flows: Navigate to /#report -> Select an issue type -> Enter a location or locality -> Optionally add a description -> Optionally upload a photo -> Submit the report -> See a confirmation view with the report summary
Navigate to /#report -> Leave a required field empty -> Submit the report -> See validation guidance for the missing information

features.name: Filter and Browse Community Reports
features.description: Lets a user view community waste reports and narrow them down using status, issue type, and locality filters, with the ability to upvote a report.
user_flows: Navigate to /#reports -> View the report list -> Select a status filter -> Select an issue type filter -> Choose a locality chip -> Review the filtered results
Navigate to /#reports -> Apply filters that produce no matches -> See an empty or no-results state with helpful guidance
Navigate to /#reports -> Open a report card -> Upvote the report -> See the updated community count or confirmation feedback

features.name: Interactive Waste Sorting Guide and Search
features.description: Helps a user find the correct disposal category for household items using search and category filters, plus a quick reference table.
user_flows: Navigate to /#guide -> Type an item name into the search field -> Review matching disposal guidance -> Scroll the quick reference table
Navigate to /#guide -> Select a waste category filter -> Review the filtered items and their suggested bins
Navigate to /#guide -> Enter a search term with no matches -> See a helpful no-result state -> Clear the search to start again

features.name: Admin Status Workflow Management
features.description: Provides a demo admin view for changing report status and deleting reports in the community workflow.
user_flows: Navigate to /#admin -> Select a report status from the dropdown -> View the toast confirmation -> See the report updated to the new status
Navigate to /#admin -> Delete a report -> See the report removed from the list

features.name: Multi-Language and Accessibility Navigation
features.description: Supports English and Hindi language switching, skip-to-content access, and keyboard-friendly navigation, including a mobile drawer on small screens.
user_flows: Navigate to /#home -> Switch the language to Hindi -> Review the interface in Hindi -> Switch back to English
Navigate to /#home -> Use the keyboard to reach the skip link and primary navigation -> Activate the focused control -> Move through the page content in order
Navigate to /#home -> Open the mobile navigation drawer on a narrow screen -> Choose a destination -> Land on the selected view

routes.description: Home view with hero section, live stats, how it works steps, recent reports preview, and language switcher
Community reports view with status and type filters, locality chips, distribution bar, and report list
Waste issue submission form with photo upload and auto-compression to <= 200KB
Waste sorting guide with interactive search/filtering, categorized waste cards (Wet, Dry, E-Waste, Hazardous), and quick reference table
Admin demo panel to update report statuses (New -> In Progress -> Resolved) and manage issues

features.name: Submit Waste Issue Report
features.description: Report a local waste issue with type, location, description, and optional photo with client-side compression
user_interactions: Select issue type from dropdown
Enter location or locality in input field
Fill optional description text
Upload photo with client-side compression (<200KB)
Click Submit Report button
See confirmation view with report details

features.name: Filter and Browse Community Reports
features.description: View, filter by status and category, and explore neighbourhood waste reports
user_interactions: Select status filter (All, New, In Progress, Resolved)
Select issue type filter
Click locality quick filter chips
Click Clear button to reset filters
Click upvote button on report cards

features.name: Interactive Waste Sorting Guide and Search
features.description: Search and filter household waste items to find proper disposal bin
user_interactions: Type search keyword into item checker search input
Click category filter chips (Wet, Dry, E-Waste, Hazardous)
Click Clear button to reset search input
Scroll through quick reference table

features.name: Admin Status Workflow Management
features.description: Update report status between New, In Progress, and Resolved
user_interactions: Navigate to Admin tab
Change status dropdown for any report
View status update toast confirmation
Delete a report

features.name: Multi-Language and Accessibility Navigation
features.description: Switch language between English and Hindi, skip to content, and navigate via keyboard
user_interactions: Click EN or HI language buttons in header
Use Tab key to focus skip link and primary navigation buttons
Toggle mobile navigation drawer on narrow screens
